style.dnbTempo: Tempo {tempo}, typical of drum and bass

checks.arrangement: stage, or an arrangement longer than 2:30
checks.noCover: square image of 1000 px or more in the mood board

scan.noOldDisk: no old disk set, or its user folder cannot be found

need.spire10: Spire 1.0.x (1.1 changed its id: Spire-1.1 and 1.5 do not replace 1.0)
need.oldList: plugin list of the old Windows
need.notWritten: the plugin does not write it in the project
need.au: {name} as VST2 or VST3 (project made on a Mac, as AU: Windows has no AU)
need.itself: {name} itself, not {other}: that is another product for Live (different id)
need.vst2: {name} as VST2: run its installer again and tick VST2
need.anyUpdate: any update of {name} (the generation is in the name)

plugins.noTemplate: no project holds {name} as VST2: no template for the conversion

store.newer: this database comes from a newer version of Spool (format {v}, this one reads up to {max}): install the latest version
store.backupFailed: could not make a copy before the update: {e}

repair.otherLive: "{name}" comes from {live} and the base from {base}: Live only converts whole projects, even between minor versions
repair.groupOrReturn: "{name}" is a group or a return: only tracks can be reused
repair.noBaseMasterChain: master chain of the base not found
repair.rackError: unreadable rack or master chain not found

fs.moveRoot: a projects folder itself cannot be moved
fs.crossRoot: from one projects folder to another: not possible yet
fs.intoItself: a folder cannot go inside itself
fs.locked: file locked: close the project in Live (or File Explorer) and try again
fs.baseNotUpdatedStuck: database not updated ({e}), and "{path}" could not go back to its place: {back}
fs.cannotPutBack: cannot put it back: "{path}" exists again
fs.someStuck: {e}; some items could not go back: {list}
fs.physicalOff: Physical arranging is off: nothing moves on the disk. Turn it on in Settings to move files.

undo.physicalOff: "{label}" can only be undone by putting files back on the disk, and physical arranging is off: nothing moved. Turn it on in Settings to undo it.

toBoard.one: {n} item put in the mood board of "{title}"
toBoard.other: {n} items put in the mood board of "{title}"

undo.lyricsAdded: Lyrics added to the mood board
undo.ideaAdded: Idea added to the mood board
undo.boardHidden: Item removed from the mood board

boardLinked.one: {n} item added to the mood board of "{title}"
boardLinked.other: {n} items added to the mood board of "{title}"

undo.boardUnlinked: Link removed from the mood board

err.copyNotRecorded: copy written, but not recorded by the app: {e}
err.busy: an analysis or a repair is running, try again in a moment
err.noActiveProject: this song has no active project
err.scanBusy: an analysis is running, try again in a moment

atelier.nothingToDo: nothing to do with this preset
atelier.busy: a processing run is already going

board.versionNotKept: previous version not kept, note not changed: {e}

notion.noTitleColumn: no column for the song name
notion.nothing: nothing to import: no new field for the recognised songs

settings.resetFailed: could not set the database aside: {e}
settings.alreadyListed: This folder is already in the list.
settings.alreadyCovered: This folder is already covered by "{path}" (or holds it).
settings.mainFolder: This is the main folder: remove the other folders first.

releases.pickInsideRoots: pick a folder inside your projects folders
releases.sharedFolder: folder shared with songs outside the release

create.pickInsideRoots: pick a folder inside your projects folders: anywhere else, the app would not see the new song
create.exists: "{name} Project" already exists in {parent}: choose another name, nothing is overwritten
create.noPart: choose at least one part that loads in this version of Live

update.busy: an analysis or a repair is running: the update waits until it is done
update.upToDate: Spool is already up to date
